t20: When you read a match prediction, you're actually reading a statement of probability, not certainty. Understanding what that means is the easiest way to put predictions in the right place. This writing is for entertainment and contains no betting advice.
t21: A prediction is probability, not certainty
t22: Saying "the home team wins" for a match doesn't mean that outcome is certain, just that it's more likely than the others. A result expected with 60% probability doesn't happen in four of ten matches — and that doesn't mean the prediction was wrong.
t23: Football being a low-scoring game increases this uncertainty. A single goal can erase ninety minutes of dominance; that's why upsets happen much more often in football than in high-scoring sports like basketball.
t24: What do terms often seen in predictions mean?
t26: Results from the last 5 matches. A short-term indicator; can be misleading on its own because it doesn't include opponent strength.
t28: Crowd support, no travel fatigue, and familiarity with the pitch. A measurable effect that varies by league.
t30: Goals the team scores and concedes per match. The foundation of over/under predictions.
t32: The effect varies greatly depending on the player's role; a missing striker is not the same as a missing backup goalkeeper.
t34: Previous matches between the teams. A weaker indicator than thought, since squads change.
t35: The app generates a single sentence for a match; it's not a serious analysis tool, just an entertaining ritual.
t38: One match carries very limited information about a team's strength.
t39: Reading too much into a streak.
t40: Consecutive results don't determine the next match; every game plays out in its own conditions.
t42: Saying "it was obvious" after a match ends is the worst way to measure prediction quality.
t44: Football prediction is a form of entertainment. Betting is subject to legal regulations for 18 and older and becomes a serious problem when it exceeds an amount you can afford to lose. No prediction, no app, and no commentary can guarantee a result.
